DOWNLOADING INFORMATION
-----------------------
The demo download links are below.  If your web browser does not enable
these links, copy the appropriate URL line and paste it into your web
browser "Address:" or "Location:" field and press enter to begin the
download.

You should choose to "Save this program to disk" when prompted by your web
browser.  After the file has been downloaded, locate it on your hard-disk
and double-click it to start the setup process.

USERS MANUAL
-----------------------
Please open and print the users manual so that you can get the most out of
Quickoffice.  There are many features to this powerful program that might
not be apparent by just taping around.  If you are using Windows, the users
manual can be found in Start / Programs / Quickoffice.
